backend/main.mo: Main backend canister managing user profiles, health metric calculations, food entries, and authorization checks.
backend/migration.mo: Migration module converting old user profile data into the new extended profile format.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping features to affected frontend files and components.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing the purpose of each major frontend file.
frontend/android-wrapper/.gitignore: Gitignore rules for Android wrapper build outputs, IDE files, logs, and temporary artifacts.
frontend/android-wrapper/app/build.gradl: Gradle build configuration for the Android wrapper, including dependencies, build types, and base URL injection.
frontend/android-wrapper/app/proguard-ru: ProGuard rules preserving WebView-related classes and app-specific packages during minification.
frontend/android-wrapper/app/src/main/An: Android manifest declaring permissions, app metadata, activity entry point, and security settings.
frontend/android-wrapper/app/src/main/ja: Android WebView wrapper that loads the NutriScan URL, handles popups, camera permissions, and WebView settings.
frontend/android-wrapper/app/src/main/re: Simple layout containing a full‑screen WebView.
Defines the app name and placeholder base URL for the NutriScan web app.
Material theme settings and color definitions for the Android wrapper app.
Excludes WebView-related data files from Android full backups.
Specifies cloud backup exclusions for WebView data.
Enforces HTTPS-only connections and whitelists Internet Computer domains.
frontend/android-wrapper/build.gradle: Project-level Gradle configuration with Kotlin and Android Gradle plugin setup.
frontend/android-wrapper/gradle.properti: Gradle performance settings and configurable NutriScan base URL.
frontend/android-wrapper/gradle/wrapper/: Gradle wrapper configuration specifying Gradle 8.2 distribution.
frontend/android-wrapper/README.md: Documentation explaining the Android WebView wrapper setup, configuration, and build steps.
frontend/android-wrapper/settings.gradle: Defines repositories, dependency management, and includes the app module.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS setup with extensive custom theme variables for light and dark modes.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point that mounts the React app and loads main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Configures routes, authentication gate, and root layout for the React app.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginButton: Login/logout button handling Internet Identity authentication states.
frontend/src/components/auth/ProfileSetu: Dialog form for collecting and validating user profile and body goal data.
frontend/src/components/camera/CapturedP: Displays a captured photo with options to retake or proceed.
frontend/src/components/chat/ChatTranscr: Scrollable chat transcript component showing messages, timestamps, and citations.
frontend/src/components/chat/SuggestedPr: Renders clickable suggested question buttons that trigger a callback on selection.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/Mainte: Displays TDEE vs today's calories with status indicators, or prompts user to complete profile if data is missing.
frontend/src/components/entries/DateRang: Provides controls to shift a date-range window and displays the formatted date span.
frontend/src/components/entries/EmptyEnt: Shows an empty-state illustration and message when no meal entries exist.
frontend/src/components/entries/EntryDet: Popup dialog showing detailed nutrition info for a food entry with adjusted values and metadata.
frontend/src/components/entries/Estimati: Handles confirmation of AI-estimated food data, allowing edits, dictation, portion adjustments, and saving the entry.
frontend/src/components/entries/PortionC: Provides sliders to adjust portion size and confidence level with optional guidance text.
frontend/src/components/entries/SimilarF: Offers alternative similar food options for selection when recognition confidence is low.
frontend/src/components/entries/TodayEnt: Shows today's logged food entries and opens a detail dialog when an entry is selected.
frontend/src/components/graphs/CaloriesO: Renders a line chart of daily calorie totals across a date range and allows selecting a day from the chart.
frontend/src/components/graphs/MacroDist: Computes total protein, carbs, and fat from entries and displays them in a pie chart.
frontend/src/components/graphs/Nutrition: Calculates a nutrition balance score based on macro ratios and confidence, displaying a grade and explanation.
frontend/src/components/graphs/WeeklyRat: Shows a 1–10 rating using colored circular markers and a star indicator.
frontend/src/components/graphs/WeeklySum: Displays a weekly nutrition summary with rating, feedback, stats, macro totals, and suggestions.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppHeader: Top navigation bar with logo, primary routes, and user login/profile display.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppLayout: Wraps the app with theme provider, header, footer, main content area, and toaster notifications.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages the authenticated or anonymous backend actor and refreshes dependent queries when it changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useCallerHealthMetric: Fetches the caller’s health metrics from the backend via the actor.
Loads suggested questions from the backend and provides a helper to find matching answers.
frontend/src/hooks/useCurrentUserProfile: Fetches and saves the current user profile using backend actor queries and mutations.
frontend/src/hooks/useFoodEntries.ts: Provides React Query hooks to fetch and add food entries via an actor API, with cache invalidation on mutations.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements an Internet Identity provider and hook for managing authentication, identity loading, and login state.
frontend/src/hooks/usePortionAdjusterGui: Fetches portion adjuster guidance text from the actor using React Query.
frontend/src/hooks/useSpeechToText.ts: Custom hook wrapping browser speech recognition to provide transcript, listening controls, and error handling.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS setup defining light and dark theme variables and base styling.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Initializes React app with QueryClient and InternetIdentityProvider, then renders the root component.
frontend/src/pages/AddEntryPage.tsx: Form UI for manually adding a food entry with nutrient fields, portion adjustments, and submission via mutation.
frontend/src/pages/CameraCapturePage.tsx: Camera capture flow enabling photo capture, preview, and estimation steps with device support handling.
frontend/src/pages/DashboardPage.tsx: Dashboard displaying today's and weekly nutrition stats, charts, and user goals using various data hooks.
frontend/src/pages/HelperChatPage.tsx: Chat interface that shows suggestions, handles user messages, and retrieves answers from a local knowledge base.
frontend/src/pages/LoginPage.tsx: Simple login screen using Internet Identity with branding and a sign‑in button.
frontend/src/utils/localFoodDataset.ts: Local static nutrition dataset defining food items, categories, keywords, and per‑100g nutrition values.
frontend/src/utils/localNutritionEstimat: Food estimation and search utilities including random image-based estimation, keyword search, and nutrition calculations.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility helpers for reading, persisting, and clearing URL parameters and session values.
frontend/src/utils/weeklyFeedback.ts: Computes weekly nutrition totals, averages, macro ratios, and generates a score with feedback and suggestions based on logged food entries and body goals.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind with custom colors, fonts, animations, container settings, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Describes the app’s current project state, architecture notes, known issues, and implemented features for a diet and health tracking system.
